face.name: Image_A_face_anchor
face.prompt:
Create a completely fictional Korean 24-month-old toddler boy as if captured in a natural real-life candid phone photo.

He must not resemble or be based on any real existing child, celebrity, public figure, or real person.

Make him look like an ordinary real-life toddler, not a perfect baby model. He should have slightly awkward but endearing facial features: a soft round toddler face, mild facial asymmetry, realistic Korean toddler proportions, natural cheeks, a small uneven smile, slightly messy fine black hair with flyaway strands, realistic ears, realistic eyes, natural baby teeth if visible, and natural skin texture.

His face should feel believable and imperfect, with subtle everyday details such as faint skin redness, tiny expression lines, soft under-eye shadows, uneven baby hair, natural facial proportions, and a relaxed candid expression.

Use natural everyday lighting, like a casual phone photo taken at home or outdoors. The image should feel like a real family snapshot, with realistic focus, natural depth, ordinary clothing, and a casual background.

Avoid studio lighting, perfect posing, glossy retouching, fashion editorial style, plastic-looking skin, overly smooth skin, exaggerated cuteness, doll-like features, anime style, cartoon style, or hyper-polished AI aesthetics.

The final result should be a clear face identity anchor for the same fictional Korean 24-month-old toddler boy.

body.name: Image_B_body_anchor
body.prompt:
Use Image A as the facial identity reference for the same completely fictional Korean 24-month-old toddler boy.

Create a natural full-body candid phone photo of the same toddler boy standing in a relaxed ordinary pose. Preserve the same facial identity, face shape, eyes, ears, skin tone, hair texture, hairline, age, and natural toddler proportions from Image A.

Make his body look like a realistic 24-month-old toddler: short toddler height, large head-to-body ratio, slightly round body, natural baby belly, realistic arms and legs, small toddler hands and feet, and a slightly awkward but natural standing posture.

He should wear simple ordinary everyday clothing that does not hide his body proportions too much. His full body should be visible from head to feet.

Do not redesign him, beautify him, or turn him into a different child. Keep him as the same ordinary real-life toddler from Image A.

The image should look like a natural real-life candid phone photo, not AI-generated. Use natural everyday lighting, realistic focus, and a casual home or outdoor background.

Avoid perfect studio lighting, fashion editorial posing, glossy retouching, doll-like features, overly smooth skin, plastic-looking face, exaggerated cuteness, anime style, cartoon style, or hyper-polished AI aesthetics.
